title: Artificial Intelligence intern
job_description: Company Description GenPark is a cutting-edge agentic discovery platform transforming global commerce through AI-driven tools. With Intelligent Brand Agents and User Agents, the platform optimizes personalized experiences by matching products, content, and interactive engagements with consumers. GenPark harnesses advanced AI content, immersive video, and interactive agents to help brands connect with and convert Gen Z audiences efficiently. Focused on innovation, GenPark is redefining the future of marketing in the digital era. Role Description This is a full-time hybrid role for an Artificial Intelligence Intern based in Singapore, offering opportunities for both on-site and remote work. The Intern will collaborate with the AI team to develop, test, and optimize machine learning models and algorithms. Day-to-day tasks include data analysis, programming, and applying cutting-edge AI techniques to enhance agentic technologies. The role also involves conducting research and generating insights to drive innovation in personalized user experiences. Qualifications Strong foundation in Computer Science and Data Science principles Proficient in Machine Learning concepts and applications Experience in Programming languages such as Python, Java, or similar Highly developed Analytical Skills for solving complex problems Ability to work collaboratively in a hybrid setting and deliver quality results Interest in AI-powered marketing technologies and familiarity with trends in personalized experiences Pursuing or completed a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field
